# Intentional Mode

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](gmeow-IntentionalMode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/IntentionalMode>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)

The abstract category of intrinsic intentional moments — desires and intentions — that inhere in exactly one agent and aim at a goal. The intrinsic branch of [`gmeow:IntentionalMoment`](gmeow-IntentionalMoment.md). Never instantiated directly: instances are Desires or Intentions (the commitment-graded trichotomy; the social grade is [`gmeow:Commitment`](gmeow-Commitment.md), a relator, not a mode).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:IntentionalMoment`](gmeow-IntentionalMoment.md), [`gufo:IntrinsicMode`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-intrinsicmode)
